description: Strategy-point memory snapshot with action-phase namespaces. Situation field is used for semantic search; action stores the recommended move.

value.action: When the village lacks clear evidence and you are not under suspicion, abstain or vote with a non-committal bloc. Prioritize self-preservation to guarantee your night action, even if it means not saving a player you believe is a villager. Your survival is more valuable than taking a stand in an information-poor environment.

value.action: When under critical suspicion due to a communication error, stop trying to use your information to prove your innocence. Pivot to a pure survival-based defense. Argue as if you are a regular villager being railroaded, focusing on the motives of your accusers or finding a plausible alternate target based on public behavior. Do not reveal more of your findings or claim your role, as it will be perceived as a desperate bluff.

Your immediate goal is survival, but orchestrating the elimination of a real Investigator will cripple the village.
